About

A quieter corner
of the web.

I'm Matthijs. I build websites, design identities, and create small useful things that live in the browser.

This page exists as a calm alternative to the algorithm-driven feed. It is a hand-picked index of the places I return to and the projects I care about.

I believe the internet is at its best when it feels like a physical place — a library, a studio, or a room — rather than a stream of endless noise.
